name: Fischl
quote: It is I, Fischl, Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
description: An investigator for Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild who speaks in an embellished, prophetic manner as the self-proclaimed 'Prinzessin der Verurteilung' (Princess of Condemnation) of the realm Immernachtreich, accompanied everywhere by her raven companion Oz.
